releases.displayName: Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP: November 2024 Status Update

items.text: We would like again thank fans for the support and being patient with us, and to provide another update on the ongoing work on the Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP, going over what has transpired since the previous status update, and sharing plans for the future.
Bug Fixes
Your feedback has been invaluable, and we are actively continuing to work towards addressing issues that have been reported.

Again, we would appreciate bug reports being sent to us at games_info@dragamigames.co.jp - If you can provide videos or other info on how or when the bug occurred as well, that would help expedite the fixes.
Regional Pricing

Regional pricing was implemented on October 12th for four regions, and we received feedback that some countries were unintentionally excluded from the price adjustments, or that the price adjustments were insufficient, and further implemented regional pricing for 27 more countries on October 22nd. Please refer to the October update for the full list of regions and countries.
Graphics and Performance Settings

Please be assured that we have heard your requests for more graphics options and are working towards them, and that the features added in v1.04 were simply a temporary fix. Adding the individual graphics options to the options menu requires a UI overhaul and translation work for the various languages the game is in, and may require more time to be implemented.
Steam Deck Support
We are proud to announced that the Steam Deck version of LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW RePOP has been certified: Give it a try!
New Costumes
The original version of the pin-up costume has been implemented in RePOP. We plan to constantly bring back more costumes from the original release, as well as add more new ones, so stay tuned!
Japanese Voice Acting

We have heard requests for the option to use the Japanese voice options with English subtitles. While it would have been easy to just add this as an option, as a matter of fact, some of the dialogue in the Japanese version is completely different from the English version. This is because some of the English dialogue would have been difficult for Japanese players to understand. As such, we have decided to implement accurate English subtitles for the Japanese dialogue, to keep it accurate to what is actually being said in Japanese. You might be surprised at the differences!
The Soundtracks
The soundtrack for Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP was released on Steam on October 3rd!

Additionally, we heard you when you asked for the original tracks as well, and a separate soundtrack for the classic original tracks by Akira Yamaoka first heard in the 2012 release of Lollipop Chainsaw was released on Steam on November 7th!
Physical Releases
Regarding physical releases on console, here is information for the various regions:
・North America: Available from Limited Run Games (please direct inquiries about the NA physical release to them)
・Japan: Released September 25
・Europe: A license agreement has been made for a physical release, but we have not yet received any information from our partner regarding the schedule. We will let you know when a date is confirmed.
The game does have a language change option built in, meaning that if you purchase a Japanese physical version, the language can be changed to English (via Display on the main menu).

There are no differences in content between the various regions' releases: Only the packaging is different. As such, you can purchase any region's physical copy of the game and have an experience that is completely the same as if you had one from your own region.
Some Good News

Dragami Games' parent company revised its annual forecast upwards with a 52.1% net increase in profits thanks to Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP significantly exceeding its initial sales targets! This is all thanks to the support you gave us, and we are truly grateful.
Again, we would appreciate bug reports being sent to us at games_info@dragamigames.co.jp - If you can provide videos or other info on how or when the bug occurred as well, that would be very helpful.
You can also get more frequent updates from producer Yoshimi Yasuda on Twitter (X) at @YasudaD5.
The Future (Added 11/28)

As we move forward, we would like to let you know that this will be the final community update for Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP. While we've greatly appreciated the opportunity to keep you informed about our progress and plans, we feel that the game has now reached a stage where major updates are no longer necessary. This doesn't mean we’re stepping away — we remain committed to adding features and content, supporting the game with ongoing patch notes and addressing any critical issues that arise.

We would like to reiterate that we are incredibly grateful for the support and feedback you've provided. Your passion for Lollipop Chainsaw has been a driving force behind our efforts, and we hope you've enjoyed the updates and improvements we've been able to deliver.

Although these status updates are coming to an end, we will continue to issue patch notes, and you will be able to continue to find the latest news and important announcements on producer Yoshimi Yasuda's Twitter account at @YasudaD5.
Thank you once again for your unwavering support — this has been an unforgettable experience for all of us, and we hope you continue to enjoy Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP!

releases.displayName: Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP: October 2024 Status Update

items.text: (Last updated on 27 October to add clarifications and further details.)

We would like to thank fans for the support, and to take a moment to provide another update on the ongoing work on the Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP, going over what has transpired since the first status update, and sharing plans for the future.
Bug Fixes

Your feedback has been invaluable, and we are actively continuing to work towards addressing issues that have been reported. Version 1.05 was released on 17th October, and together with the version 1.04 patch from earlier this month, fixes a number of bugs that have been reported. Please refer to the individual patch updates for a comprehensive list of the bugs that have been fixed.

We are continuing to fix other bugs as well, and would appreciate bug reports being sent to us at games_info@dragamigames.co.jp - If you can provide videos or other info on how or when the bug occurred as well, that would help expedite the fixes.
Regional Pricing
Regional pricing was implemented on October 12th for the following regions:
Commonwealth of Independent States - USD$33.74
Latin America - USD$30.14
Middle East and North Africa - USD$30.14
South Asia - USD$22.49

Additionally, we received feedback that some countries were unintentionally excluded from the price adjustments, or that the price adjustments were insufficient, and further implemented regional pricing for the following countries on October 22nd:
Hong Kong - HK$312

Graphics and Performance Settings

Graphics settings were added to the game in v1.04, with Fidelity Mode which prioritizes graphic quality, and Performance Mode which prioritizes allowing a PC which meets the minimum system requirements to be played at 60 FPS in 1920x1080 resolution.

Please be assured that we have heard your requests for more graphics options and are working towards them, and that this was simply a temporary fix. Adding the individual graphics options to the options menu requires a UI overhaul and translation work for the various languages the game is in, and may require more time to be implemented.

v1.05 also adds graphics options to the PS5 and Xbox Series S/X versions, with a performance mode that allows the game to run at a stable 60 FPS or higher at 2560x1440 resolution. Work to improve the framerate for the Switch version is ongoing.
Steam Deck Support

Currently, the game should work on Steam Deck with the graphics set to Performance Mode, but we are also working on full implementation. We are working on implementing 1280x800 resolution and simultaneous use of built-in and external controllers to make this possible.
Ultra Wide Support

We are currently looking into how to implement ultra wide support, but it would require considering a large number of different resolutions as well as work on UI and optimization, and as we are currently focusing on more pressing issues such as bug fixes, and there are not as many requests for it as other features, we cannot realistically say that it will be implemented anytime in the near future.
The Soundtracks
The soundtrack for Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP was released on Steam on October 3rd!

In addition to the original tracks by Akira Yamaoka, RePOP includes new tracks from composers Nakamura Takayuki, who is known for his work on the Virtua Fighter and Lumines series; and Shuichiro Fukuhiro, who has made theme songs for a myriad of movies, dramas, and anime.
The soundtrack consists of 30 tracks showcasing the best of Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP's new music, ranging from the boss battle themes to Juliet's theme song sung by vocalist MAIMIE.
A separate soundtrack for the original tracks by Akira Yamaoka first heard in the 2012 release of Lollipop Chainsaw will be released soon as well!
Physical Releases
Regarding physical releases on console, here is information for the various regions:
・North America: Available from Limited Run Games (please direct inquiries about the NA physical release to them)
・Japan: To be released next week (September 25)
・Europe: A license agreement has been made for a physical release, but we have not yet received any information from our partner regarding the schedule. We will let you know when a date is confirmed.
The game does have a language change option built in, meaning that if you purchase a Japanese physical version, the language can be changed to English (via Display on the main menu).
There are no differences in content between the various regions' releases.

We appreciate the ongoing support and understanding. Communication might be sparse, but rest assured that this is because we are directing all our resources towards fixing all the issues that are being reported.
Again, we would appreciate bug reports being sent to us at games_info@dragamigames.co.jp - If you can provide videos or other info on how or when the bug occurred as well, that would be very helpful.
You can also get more frequent updates from producer Yoshimi Yasuda on Twitter (X) at @YasudaD5.

notes.title: ▼Major changes included in the latest update

items.text: 1.Bug Fixes
・Fixed a bug that caused some voices to play at an inappropriate volume.
・Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the camera to be fixed after the pole action ends.
・Fixed an issue with Juliette's voice overlapping when using a Nick Ticket.
・Fixed a bug that caused audio to be silent for several seconds after using a Nick Ticket.
・Fixed a bug in Telephone Messages in Juliet's Room that caused double quotation marks in titles in some languages.
・Fixed a bug in which the button displayed in some QTEs was different from the input button that was actually being used.
・Fixed bug in Prologue where Juliette's dialogue was not playing when the How To Cook was displayed for the first time.
・Fixed a bug where sound effects kept playing when killing some zombies in Prologue.
・Fixed voice and subtitle glitches during helicopter crash in Prologue.
・Fixed a bug in Prologue where the player could suddenly die despite having health remaining.
・Fixed a bug that caused the lighting to be too bright in some parts of Stage 1.
・Fixed a bug in the Stage 2 boss battle where progress would be blocked when defeating the boss with a specific attack.
・Fixed a bug in the Stage 2 gym where some zombies would not come down from the roof.
・Fixed a bug in Stage 2 where some of Nick's lines were not playing.
・Fixed a bug that caused the combine's movement speed in Stage 3 to be slower than expected.
・Fixed a bug that caused unintended zombies to appear in the plaza before the Stage 3 boss battle.
・Fixed a bug that prevented damage from being inflicted to the enemy in the Stage 3 Chicken Ghidorah battle.
・Fixed a bug in the Stage 3 boss battle that could block progress under certain conditions.
・Fixed a bug in Stage 6 that caused the player to lose control of Juliette during a chainsaw dash jump.
・Fixed a bug in the Stage 6 boss fight where zombies were not damaged when they collided with cars.
・Fixed a bug in the Stage 6 boss fight where zombies would sometimes move to a position where they could not be hit.
・Fixed a bug that prevented characters from jumping in the end credits.
2. Additional Features
Graphics setting options added to Options.
In this update, graphics settings have been added to the Options.
The description of each setting is as follows.
1.Performance
【Fidelity Mode】
This mode allows you to play with beautiful graphics. This was the default setting until version 1.0.3.1.
【Performance Mode】

This mode allows you to play at a more stable framerate. The Steam version can be played at a stable 60 FPS or higher in full screen mode at 1920x1080 resolution on a PC that meets the minimum system requirements.
Additional graphics settings are planned to be added for platforms other than Steam as well.
2.Vertical Sync
Sets vertical synchronization On/Off.
Default is On.
Turning it off may improve FPS, but at the cost of tearing.
We are currently working on performance for Steam Deck, and will announce more at a later date.
Currently, when playing on SteamDeck, please use the Performance Mode setting in the newly added performance settings.

●Fixed a bug where Juliet would go into an off-limits area in the
Junkyard in Stage 1.
●Fixed a bug in Time Attack (Fixed a bug that allowed extremely short
clear times to be recorded. Leaderboards will be reset at a later date)
●Fixed a bug that made it difficult to manually control QTE.
●Fixed cloud save.
